name: ratelens-mrp-mismatch-index
title: Ratelens MRP Mismatch Index (India)
description: Products where Amazon.in and Flipkart declare different Maximum Retail Prices for the same item, matched on manufacturer model code. Monthly frozen editions.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Manufacturer model code used to match the product across platforms.

fields.name: a_price
fields.description: Selling price observed on the Amazon.in listing, INR.

fields.name: a_mrp
fields.description: Maximum Retail Price declared by the Amazon.in listing, INR.

fields.name: a_off
fields.description: Discount percentage advertised on the Amazon.in listing.

fields.name: f_price
fields.description: Selling price observed on the Flipkart listing, INR.

fields.name: f_mrp
fields.description: Maximum Retail Price declared by the Flipkart listing, INR.

fields.name: f_off
fields.description: Discount percentage advertised on the Flipkart listing.

fields.name: gap
fields.description: Percentage difference between the two declared MRPs.

fields.name: grade
fields.description: Confidence that the mismatch is real: High, Medium or Low.

fields.name: can_name
fields.description: True only when a third listing lets a majority identify which platform is the outlier. When false, the data shows the two declared MRPs cannot both be correct, but not which one is wrong.
